children.value: Frequently Asked Questions
Can you refill a prefilled vape pod?

No. The Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod and its 8ml container arrive sealed with no fill port, and the liquid is matched to the mesh coil inside the pod. When the window shows the pod is empty, you click on a new pack, which keeps it inside UK TPD rules.
Can I refill my VOZOL vape?

Not by hand. The Vozol Sleek Max 10K is refilled by swapping the pod: pull the empty 2ml pod off the magnetic base, fit a fresh Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod with its 8ml container, and wait five minutes before the first draw. Only the refillable Vozol Ace kits take loose e-liquid.
How long does a 10,000 puff disposable vape typically last?

A Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod and container set carries 10ml, and the 10,000 figure assumes short puffs. In practice that is close to a month at around 300 puffs a day, about three weeks at 500, and 10 to 12 days at 800 or more. Long draws and Rich mode shorten all three.
What is a prefilled pod in a vape?

A prefilled pod is a sealed cartridge that arrives already filled with e-liquid and carries its own coil, so you fit it to a rechargeable battery and throw only the pod away when it is empty. The Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod adds an 8ml container that tops up the 2ml pod automatically.
Do Vozol Sleek Max 10K pods fit the Vozol Vista Plug 10000, Mate 54K or Ace Max?
No. The Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod has its own magnetic base and only seats on the Vozol Sleek Max 10K kit. The Mate 54K uses Vozol Mate 18k pods and the Ace Max uses refillable cartridges.
How do I change the pod on the Vozol Sleek Max 10K?
Pull the old pod straight off the battery, remove the plugs from the new 2ml pod, fit the 8ml container and click the pod onto the magnets. Wait five minutes before the first puff so the coil is wet.
Why does my Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod taste burnt?
Usually a dry coil. Wait five minutes after fitting a new pod, pause between puffs and switch out of Rich mode. If the pod window shows it is empty the taste will not recover; fit a new pod.
How much e-liquid is in a Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod pack?

10ml in total: a 2ml prefilled pod plus an 8ml refill container, both at 20mg nicotine salt. The pod itself never holds more than the TPD limit of 2ml, because the container feeds it a little at a time.
Are Vozol Sleek Max 10K pods legal in the UK?

Yes. The pod holds 2ml at 20mg, both inside TPD limits, Vozol's MHRA notification lists the Sleek Max pod as a refill container, and the kit is rechargeable with replaceable pods, so the June 2025 disposable ban does not apply.
Can I switch flavours before a Vozol Sleek Max 10K pod is empty?

Yes. Pull the half-used pod off, refit its silicone plugs, store it upright and click a different flavour on. The first pod goes back on later and carries on where it left off, so one kit can run two flavours.
